metadata.name: GetUserRegistrationParameters
metadata.description: This API is used to get User Registration Parameters Set in the System.

request_fields.name: Source
request_fields.description: Source of API Consumer For external system expected sources will be WEB. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: IPAddress
request_fields.description: IP Address of Client / Application Hosting Server Example: 10.206.0.204 Allowable Values: 15

request_fields.name: DateFormat
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Values are: 1 : MM/dd/yyyy HH:MM:SS (Default) 2 : MM/dd/yy HH:MM:SS 3 : dd/MM/yyyy HH:MM:SS Allowable Values: 25

request_fields.name: CurrencyCode
request_fields.description: Currency Code Place Holder for Future Use. Valid Values: Refer Appendix Section - Currency Code Example:840 = US Dollar Condition:If no value is passed, default value = 840 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CurrencySymbolType
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. CurrencySymbolType: 1: Currency Sign like $ 2: 3 ALPHA Currency Code like USD Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: Language
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Language: en: means use English Default: en - English Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: ExternalIP
request_fields.description: IP Address of end user of API Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: SessionID
request_fields.description: Session identifier of the API Example: 000028;026;1349906692 Allowable Values: 100

request_fields.name: APIVersion
request_fields.description: Version of the API to be invoked. Example: 2.0 API Version Current Version 2.0 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CallerID
request_fields.description: Caller ID of source from where API is initiated it is End User Caller ID Example: 7204454214 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: CalledID
request_fields.description: Called ID of destination for which API is initiated It is Destination Called ID Example: 7314145404 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: RequestTime
request_fields.description: Request Date Time of API Format: MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm:ss Example:01/15/2020 10:05:23

request_fields.name: CardNumber
request_fields.description: Card Number of account holder Valid Values: 0-9 Format:XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX Example:1236547896325874 Condition:At least one of CardNumber/AdminNumber/AccountNumber is required. Allowable Values: 16

request_fields.name: AccountNumber
request_fields.description: Account number of cardholder/AccountHolder. Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXXXXXXXX Example:7314145404 Condition:At least one of CardNumber/AdminNumber/AccountNumber is required. Allowable Values: 19

request_fields.name: AdminNumber
request_fields.description: Admin number. Valid Values: 0-9 Example: 12345 Condition:At least one of CardNumber/AdminNumber/AccountNumber is required.

request_fields.name: InstitutionID
request_fields.description: Unique identification number for Institution Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXX Example:Fixed value needs to pass which is provided by Corecard.

request_fields.name: ProductID
request_fields.description: ID assigned to a Program Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXX Example:Fixed value provided by CoreCard.

response_fields.name: Status
response_fields.description: API Status Example: Success - true, Error - false

response_fields.name: ErrorCode
response_fields.description: Response Message Error Code Allowable Values: 10

children.name: SecurityQuestionsList
children.description: Get or Set listSecurityQuestions

children.name: SecurityQuestionID
children.description: ID of the Security Questions set Valid Values: 0-9 Format:X Example:1234

children.name: SecurityQuestionDescription
children.description: Description of the Security Question ID Valid Values: a-z Example: What is your Pet Name? Allowable Values: 100

children.name: RegistrationParameterList
children.description: Get or Set listSecurityQuestions

children.name: ParameterID
children.description: SelfService User Registration Parameter, must return the Parameter Name set in Registration Fields in System on Product Valid Values: '1' - Address Line 1 '2' - Address Line 2 '3' - Country '4' - City '5'- Zip '6' - State '7' - Email ID '8' - Last Four Digits Of Primary ID '14' - DOB '16' - CVV2 '18' - OTPFormat:XX Example: 8

children.name: IsRequired
children.description: Defines SelfService Registration Parameter Set in  Registration Fields in System is Mandatory or Optional Valid Values: '0' - Optional, '1' - Mandatory Example: 1

children.name: NumberOfQuestionsOffered
children.description: Number of Questions Offered Set in System Example: 1,5,10 etc

children.name: OTPMode
children.description: The Mode of OTP Email ID or Mobile Number or Both Valid Values: '1' = Mobile Number, '2' = Email ID and '3' = Both Format:X Example:1

children.name: AdminNumber
children.description: Details can be obtained by admin number (Embossing Acctid) Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXXX Example:12345

children.name: CardNumber
children.description: Card Number of account holder Valid Values: 0-9 Format:XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX Example:1236547896325874 Allowable Values: 16

children.name: AccountNumber
children.description: Account number of cardholder/AccountHolder. Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXXXXXXXX Example:7314145404 Allowable Values: 19

children.name: MinPasswordLength
children.description: Minimum Password Length  Required As per password Policy Valid Values:- 0-9 Format:XX Example:5

children.name: MaxPasswordLength
children.description: Maximum Password Length  allowed As per password Policy Valid Values:- 0-9 Format:XX Example:5

children.name: NoOfUppCaseReq
children.description: Number of Upper Case letters Required in a Password As per the password Policy Valid Values:- 0-9 Format:XX Example:5

children.name: NoOfLowCaseReq
children.description: Number of Lower Case letters Required in a Password As per the password Policy Valid Values:- 0-9 Format:XX Example:5

children.name: NoOfDigitReq
children.description: Number of Digits Required in a Password As per the password Policy Valid Values:- 0-9 Format:XX Example:5

children.name: NoOfSymbolReq
children.description: Number of Symbols Required in a Password As per the password Policy Valid Values:- 0-9 Format:XX Example:5

children.name: MinAlphaReq
children.description: Number of Alphabets Required in a Password As per the password Policy Valid Values:- 0-9 Format:XX Example:5

children.name: CompSameConsecutive
children.description: If Setting Same Consecutive Passwords is allowed or not as per the password policy Valid Values: 0 = No, 1 = Yes

children.name: PartialUserName
children.description: If Partial UserName is allowed or not as per the password policy Valid Values: 0 = No, 1 = Yes
